items.title: 9.6 Common ion effect (common ion ka asar) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.6, printed pages 198-199.

blocks.title: Common ion effect
blocks.text: Kisi weak electrolyte mein aisa ion dalna jo us mein pehle se maujood ho (common ion), us ki ionization ko suppress (daba) deta hai. Isi ko common ion effect kehte hain.

Sodium chloride ko purify (saaf) karne ke liye brine (NaCl ka saturated solution) mein hydrogen chloride gas guzari jati hai. Solution mein sodium chloride poori tarah ionize hota hai. Is ka equilibrium constant expression yeh hai:
HCl bhi solution mein ionize hoti hai:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein “HCl(g) (s)” chhapa hai; HCl yahan gas hai, “(s)” ghalti se chhapa hai.

HCl gas guzarne se Cl⁻ ion ki concentration barh jati hai. Equilibrium constant ki value wahi rakhne ke liye NaCl crystal ban kar solution se bahar aa jata hai. Yahi common ion effect hai. Less soluble (kam ghulne wale) electrolyte ke solution mein common ion dalne se us ki ionization dab jati hai aur bina ionize hue (unionized) hisse ki concentration barh jati hai, jo precipitate (solid particles) ban kar nikal sakta hai.
More Examples of Common Ion Effect (common ion effect ki aur examples)

i. Less soluble (kam ghulne wala) salt KClO₃ pani mein hai. Us mein more soluble (zyada ghulne wala) salt KCl dalein to common ion K⁺ ki wajah se KClO₃ ki solubility (ghulne ki salahiyat) kam ho jati hai; us ki ionization dab jati hai aur woh precipitate ban kar beth jata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein KClO₃ se “ClO⁻” bante dikhaya gaya hai; KClO₃ se chlorate ion ClO₃⁻ banta hai.

ii. Isi tarah weak acid H₂S ka dissociation strong acid HCl dal kar dabaya ja sakta hai. Yahan H⁺ common ion hai. Acidic solution mein H₂S kam dissociate hota hai, is liye S²⁻ ion ki concentration kam rehti hai.
S²⁻ ki yeh kam concentration salt analysis mein second group ke basic radicals ko precipitate karne mein madad karti hai.

iii. NH₃ solution mein NH₄Cl dalne se NH₄Cl se aane wale bohat zyada NH₄⁺ ki wajah se OH⁻ ki concentration dab jati hai. NH₄Cl strong electrolyte hai. In dono ka mixture salt analysis mein third group ke basic radicals ka group reagent hai.
Common ion effect qualitative analysis aur buffers banane mein bohat istemal hota hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Equilibrium mein jis ion ki amount bahar se barha di jaye, reaction us ion ko kam karne ki taraf (ulti taraf) chalti hai. Is liye kam ghulne wala salt ya weak acid aur kam ionize hota hai.

items: Common ion weak ya kam ghulne wale electrolyte ki ionization dabata hai.
Brine mein HCl gas → NaCl crystallize; KCl → KClO₃ precipitate; HCl → H₂S kam dissociate (group II ke liye kam S²⁻); NH₄Cl → NH₃ mein OH⁻ kam (group III reagent).
